full_judgment: 2. Subject matter of the suit is Municipal holding No. 294(New) (1962-63) of Chittagong standing on R.S. plot No.412 of R.S. Khatian No.41 of mouza Rahamatgonj, P.S. Kotwali, Chittagong. Schedule A is the portion of the holding in respect of which confirmation of possession has been prayed for. Schedule B is the other portion in respect of which recovery of possession has been prayed for. The suit property belonged to Sreemati Subashini Sinha by purchase from Sarat Chandra Mozumder by registered deed dated 13-2-47. The superior landlord Haji Abdus Samad in execution of a decree for arrears of rent put the holding to sale and the plaintiff Md. Abdur Rabban auction purchased the same on 27-2-62. The plaintiff obtained delivery of possession of the land and houses on 18-5-62. The plaintiff instituted this suit being Title Suit No. 18 of 1963 in the Court of Subordinate Judge, 1st Court, Chittagong for declaration of title and recovery and confirmation of possession as aforesaid alleging that the defendant no. 1 was a trespasser and was claiming title to the suit property. The defendant no.1 contested the suit alleging that one Gul Mohammad had trespassed into the suit property in the year 1948 and the defendant no.1 was possessing the disputed houses and land as a tenant under Gul Mohammad since then. Defendant no. 2 was inducted by defendant no. 1 as a tenant in schedule A. Plaintiff who is the son of the defendant no.2 is living in the house of schedule A with defendant no 2. The defendant further alleged that Gul Mohammad acquired title by adverse possession for more than 12 years. He also denied that plaintiff ever took any delivery of possession.
